add.title: Transgender rights in Argentina (Wikipedia) — Prisons section: 2025 women's-prison housing restriction
add.summary: Wikipedia article 'Transgender rights in Argentina' (rev. 23 Aug 2026), Prisons section: in February 2025, President Javier Milei's government implemented a ban on being housed in a women's prison for trans women convicted of sexual crimes, human trafficking, or any violent crime against a woman. The dated rule is a restriction on women's-prison housing for trans women in specific conviction categories; the article records no other trans-specific housing rule or separate trans unit, implying the operative baseline (for trans women not in those conviction categories) is women's-prison housing. National-level policy; the article contains no Buenos Aires province-specific placement rule.
